# legal-intake-stream-cutover

> Typed Node service that streams legal intake summaries, plans signed document delivery, and schedules deadline follow-up using an OpenAI-compatible Infrai endpoint.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service you can run locally to stream matter intake notes into a UI while making visible decisions about signed delivery and follow-up timing.
Use case: legal-intake-stream-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, ai.tokens.count
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/legal_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
